summary.text: Eric Ebersole is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 44A and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is on the November ballot against Republican Chuck Linton.
A former high school mathematics teacher, he serves on the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Eric Ebersole was born in Baltimore and graduated from Catonsville High School in 1976.
He earned a B.S. in mathematics education in 1980 and an M.S. in mathematics education in 1986, both from the University of Maryland, College Park.

Ebersole began teaching at Wilde Lake High School in 1980 and later served as mathematics department chair at Reservoir High School and department chair at Marriotts Ridge High School, according to his legislative biography.
He was an adjunct instructor in mathematics education at the University of Maryland, Baltimore County from 2004 to 2008.
Ballotpedia lists Ebersole's tenure in the House of Delegates as beginning in 2015, and shows him as the only candidate in the 2026 Democratic primary for District 44A.
The General Assembly website lists him as a member of the Ways and Means Committee.
